verified.backupRestore: The rehearsal clone uses separate file paths while reusing source profileId/localDbId and matching vault mapping; missing/wrong mapping is a separate failure. Interrupted backup/restore preserves the source and never exposes/replaces a partial destination. Portable recovery is not inferred.
verified.outbox: Soft and hard limits each cover −1, exact, and +1; soft warning appears only above the threshold, hard-limit equality may commit, and +1 returns OUTBOX_FULL while preserving prior committed state.
verified.workerAndImage: DB query and image decode cancellation are separate. A lightweight event-loop request must complete before the held worker is released. Image byte/pixel admission and volatile decoded-cache limits use canonical limits and explicitly exclude T04 decoder choice/quality/performance.
verified.objectGc: GC checks reference graph, object presence, and transaction consistency without depending on the unfrozen durable-byte accounting formula.
verified.sourceTraceability: Image admission references 03 §4.2 and its canonical limit keys.

limitations: The current specification does not freeze a measurable local.totalBytes formula, including database/WAL and shared-reference charging. Budget/WAL charge fixtures remain NOT_RUN until exact components and double-count rules are specified and reviewed.
T06 is not accepted. SQLCipher native linkage, OS vault behavior, crash/disk-full recovery, and actual backup/restore remain NOT_RUN.
